\section[(dialogue)]{Times of day, seasons and months — a first pass}

\label{lesson:MW-R99-first-pass-times-of-day-seasons-and-months}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a stepwell and a pond.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item midday, the evening, in the early morning, dawn, the day after tomorrow; the day before yesterday
  \item afterwards, Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday
  \item Saturday, Sunday, Chait, Baisakh, Jeth
  \item Savan, Bhadvo, Asoj, Kati, Migsar
  \item Pos, Magh, the hot season, the cold season, the rainy season
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Midday? (\textbf{\mw{दोपार}}, \emph{dopār}.) The evening? (\textbf{\mw{आथण}}, \emph{āthaṇ}.) In the early morning? (\textbf{\mw{दिनूगै}}, \emph{dinūgai}.) Dawn? (\textbf{\mw{परभात}}, \emph{parbhāt}.) The day after tomorrow; the day before yesterday? (\textbf{\mw{परसूं}}, \emph{parsū̃}.) Afterwards? (\textbf{\mw{पछै}}, \emph{pachhai}.) Monday? (\textbf{\mw{सोमवार}}, \emph{somvār}.) Tuesday? (\textbf{\mw{मंगळवार}}, \emph{maṅgaḷvār}.) Thursday? (\textbf{\mw{गुरुवार}}, \emph{guruvār}.) Friday? (\textbf{\mw{सुकरवार}}, \emph{sukarvār}.) Saturday? (\textbf{\mw{सनिवार}}, \emph{sanivār}.) Sunday? (\textbf{\mw{रविवार}}, \emph{ravivār}.) Chait? (\textbf{\mw{चैत}}, \emph{chait}.) Baisakh? (\textbf{\mw{बैसाख}}, \emph{baisākh}.) Jeth? (\textbf{\mw{जेठ}}, \emph{jeṭh}.) Savan? (\textbf{\mw{सावण}}, \emph{sāvaṇ}.) Bhadvo? (\textbf{\mw{भादवो}}, \emph{bhādvo}.) Asoj? (\textbf{\mw{आसोज}}, \emph{āsoj}.) Kati? (\textbf{\mw{काती}}, \emph{kātī}.) Migsar? (\textbf{\mw{मिगसर}}, \emph{migsar}.) Pos? (\textbf{\mw{पोस}}, \emph{pos}.) Magh? (\textbf{\mw{माघ}}, \emph{māgh}.) The hot season? (\textbf{\mw{उनाळो}}, \emph{unāḷo}.) The cold season? (\textbf{\mw{सियाळो}}, \emph{siyāḷo}.) The rainy season? (\textbf{\mw{चौमासो}}, \emph{chaumāso}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Where things are — a second pass}

\label{lesson:MW-R99-second-pass-where-things-are}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for spring and at daybreak.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item spring, at daybreak, time, every day, nowadays
  \item where, over there, in front, behind, on top of
  \item underneath, in the middle, near, opposite, left
  \item right, a town square, a crossroads, a turn, a path
  \item a route, a courtyard, an enclosure, a stepwell, a pond
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Spring? (\textbf{\mw{बसंत}}, \emph{basant}.) At daybreak? (\textbf{\mw{तड़कै}}, \emph{taṛkai}.) Time? (\textbf{\mw{बगत}}, \emph{bagat}.) Every day? (\textbf{\mw{रोज}}, \emph{roj}.) Nowadays? (\textbf{\mw{आजकाल}}, \emph{ājkāl}.) Where? (\textbf{\mw{कठै}}, \emph{kaṭhai}.) Over there? (\textbf{\mw{उठै}}, \emph{uṭhai}.) In front? (\textbf{\mw{आगै}}, \emph{āgai}.) Behind? (\textbf{\mw{लारै}}, \emph{lārai}.) On top of? (\textbf{\mw{माथै}}, \emph{māthai}.) Underneath? (\textbf{\mw{हेठै}}, \emph{heṭhai}.) In the middle? (\textbf{\mw{बिचै}}, \emph{bichai}.) Near? (\textbf{\mw{कनै}}, \emph{kanai}.) Opposite? (\textbf{\mw{सामी}}, \emph{sāmī}.) Left? (\textbf{\mw{डावो}}, \emph{ḍāvo}.) Right? (\textbf{\mw{जीमणो}}, \emph{jīmaṇo}.) A town square? (\textbf{\mw{चौक}}, \emph{chauk}.) A crossroads? (\textbf{\mw{चौराहो}}, \emph{chaurāho}.) A turn? (\textbf{\mw{मोड़}}, \emph{moṛ}.) A path? (\textbf{\mw{गेलो}}, \emph{gelo}.) A route? (\textbf{\mw{रस्तो}}, \emph{rasto}.) A courtyard? (\textbf{\mw{आंगणो}}, \emph{ā̃gaṇo}.) An enclosure? (\textbf{\mw{बाड़ो}}, \emph{bāṛo}.) A stepwell? (\textbf{\mw{बावड़ी}}, \emph{bāvṛī}.) A pond? (\textbf{\mw{तळाव}}, \emph{taḷāv}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
